definitions: The devotion of time and attention to acquiring knowledge, especially from books or by means of academic work.
A detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.
A room, especially in a house, that is used for reading, writing, or academic work.
A piece of music composed for the purpose of practicing or improving a particular point of technique.
A preliminary drawing or painting made for a larger work.
examples: She locked herself away to study for her exams.
The study revealed a significant correlation.
He retired to his study after dinner.
The artist made several studies before the final portrait.
